import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveVisit } from '@src/api/bot/cave-visit-queries';
import { BackendAPIError } from '@src/api/bot/client';
import { sendVisitedCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { resolveTargetUid } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const targetUid = await resolveTargetUid(e.MessageText ?? '', mention);

  if (!targetUid) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请输入目标UID，格式：/查看灵田 123 或 /查看灵田 @目标');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '查看灵田', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  let overview: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getBackendCaveVisit>>;

  try {
    overview = await getBackendCaveVisit(bid, uid, targetUid);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof BackendAPIError) || error.status !== 404) {
      throw error;
    }
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('未找到目标道友。');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '查看灵田', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const footer = [
    { label: '查看信息', command: `/查看信息 ${overview.ownerUid}` },
    { label: '返回灵田', command: '/我的灵田' }
  ];

  sendVisitedCavePlotPage({
    title: '查看灵田',
    bid,
    isPrivate,
    message,
    overview,
    footer
  });
});
